search_intent: Compare FOB and CIF quotations for Chinese vehicles shipped to a Middle Eastern destination
buyer_task: Separate FOB-CIF shipping obligations from Gulf/GCC conformity, national import controls and registration for a specific Middle Eastern state and terminal.

source_registry.facts_supported: Incoterms(r) 2020 Checklist: FAS/FOB maritime/inland-waterway only; FCA for any mode incl multimodal and terminal delivery; C-group (CFR/CIF/CPT/CIP) are shipment contracts - risk passes on delivery (on board) in seller's country while seller pays main carriage; under CIF seller must arrange minimum-cover cargo insurance (LMA/IUA Clauses C or similar), CIP requires all-risk cover (Clauses A).

WCO Valuation FAQ: invoice/transaction price is not automatically customs value; whether freight/insurance is added depends on importing country national law; customs may reject declared value after persistent doubt; six valuation methods apply in sequence (transaction value, identical, similar, deductive, computed, fallback). Scope = global framework only, proves no national rule.
WTO Agreement on Implementation of Article VII GATT (customs valuation); framework not re-read this session; proves no national rule.
Cited as the GCC conformity certificate authentication platform; detailed Mutabiq operations (VIN upload/label/recall) were NOT reopened this session.

source_registry.organization: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority of Saudi Arabia
source_registry.facts_supported: Light vehicles/buses/light transport <=3.5t model must not exceed 5 years; heavy trucks >3.5t operational life <=5 years; energy-efficiency certificate + SASO inquiry; prohibited: salvage/sunk/fire/overturn/structural-damage, ex-taxi/police, RHD-to-LHD converted, tampered chassis, stolen; valuation uses submitted invoice, if unsatisfied local-agent new-car lists with 10% annual depreciation capped 50%; GCC first-point-of-entry fee mechanism; resident one private car per 3 years. Last update 31 Dec 2025.

Chairman Decision No.12 of 2015 Customs Value Instructions: Art.2 carriage per carrier freight receipts (estimate from identical/similar if absent); insurance per insurer receipts, if absent add 1% of goods value to reach customs value (CIF); authority may doubt declared value; importer given up to 90 days to justify; related-party and discount rules.

source_registry.organization: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology
source_registry.facts_supported: Smart e-service for imported-used-vehicle licences; national requirements prohibit import/licensing/insuring of 7 categories (burnt-out, scrapped, flooded, disassembled, damaged-beyond-repair, major manufacturing defect, etc.); imported light vehicles for re-export excluded. Page is a closed 2023 consultation describing the standing service; site updated 17/06/2026.

claims.claim: FOB risk transfers on board; CIF seller pays sea carriage and arranges insurance but risk transfers on board in China, not at Gulf arrival.
FCA fits terminal container delivery; CIP fits insured multimodal carriage.
Invoice amount is not automatically customs value.
WTO Customs Valuation Agreement is the global treaty basis (not reopened; no Gulf national rule).

Qatar customs-value rules: freight follows carrier receipts (estimate from similar if absent) and insurance follows insurer receipts, otherwise 1% is added to reach CIF; customs may doubt declared value.

Saudi ZATCA imposes model-age limits (<=5yr light; <=5yr operational life heavy trucks), energy-efficiency/SASO inquiry, prohibited salvage/flood/fire/structural/RHD-converted vehicles, and its own valuation (invoice else agent lists, 10%/yr depreciation capped 50%).
